units.source_text: 破罐子破摔，再挣扎一次，在他手伸向头上的沙子的瞬间，沙的压力忽然消失。

en.t: Driven to desperation, he struggled once more, and the instant his hand reached toward the sand above his head, the pressure of the sand suddenly vanished.

units.source_text: 他让沙子给吐了出来，一个跟斗翻落到了洞底。

en.t: The sand spat him out, and he tumbled head over heels down to the bottom of the pit.

units.source_text: 左肩着地，“咔嚓”一声，像掰开一次性筷子的声音。

en.t: He landed on his left shoulder with a crack, like the sound of disposable chopsticks being snapped apart.
He did not feel any particular pain.

units.source_text: 就像不愿被他抓出伤痕似的，细细的沙子毫无表情地唰唰流过沙壁落下来，不久便停了。

en.t: As if unwilling to let him gouge scars into it, the fine sand slid expressionlessly down the sand wall with a rustling sound, then soon stopped.

units.source_text: 即使这样，还是留下了极小一块伤疤。

en.t: Even so, an exceedingly small scar remained.
